# Vendored code

- `LibDeflate.lua`: [LibDeflate](https://github.com/SafeteeWoW/LibDeflate) 1.0.2 by Haoqian He, under the zlib
  License (its header kept). C_EncodingUtil's deflate and zlib (lua/encoding.lua).

Everything else in AddonSim is its own: base64, hex, CBOR and gzip (lua/encoding.lua) are written from the RFCs.
